items.title: Microsoft Teams Issue Blocks Users From Opening Embedded Office Documents
items.description: A widespread service issue is impacting Microsoft Teams users globally this Thursday, preventing many from opening embedded Microsoft Office documents within the collaboration platform. Reports began surfacing early this morning, with users expressing frustration over their inability to access essential files like Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and PowerPoint presentations directly in their…

items.title: 28,000+ Citrix Instances Exposed to Active 0-Day RCE Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild
items.description: A critical zero-day remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-7775, is affecting over 28,000 Citrix instances worldwide. The flaw is being actively exploited in the wild, prompting the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) to add it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.
